title: Understanding MSE
text: The Mean Squared Error (MSE) is calculated by taking the average of the squares of the differences between the observed and predicted values.

title: Identify Observed Values
text: From the graph, identify the observed tip values for the given temperatures.

title: Identify Predicted Values
text: Use the regression line to find the predicted tip values for the given temperatures.

title: Calculate Squared Differences
text: Calculate the squared differences between the observed and predicted values for each data point.

title: Calculate MSE
text: Sum the squared differences and divide by the number of observations to find the MSE.
